stem: For the stated DC motor convention, which equation identifies rotational back EMF without confusing it with the complete terminal voltage balance?

options.text: e_back=Ri, while V=k_eω regardless of armature current.
e_back=L di/dt, while rotational speed affects only resistance.
e_back=V+Ri+L di/dt under the stated opposing-EMF convention.

assumptions: Motoring sign convention: back EMF opposes the applied terminal voltage; fixed field and compatible motor constants.
